name: com.m4bwav.universe-generator
description: Seeded universe, galaxy, star system, planet and moon generator for games and fiction. One seed gives the same galaxy on every platform: names, star types, planets, lanes, regions, danger and story tags, as plain C# data with no engine dependencies.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that writes the galaxy of a seed to the console: its systems, descriptors, danger and factions.
